'''Desson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] laborer who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Zarra had been damaged during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and Desson participated in an effort to rebuild the city.
